prompts.bellstrider: Convert this EXACT approved pixel-art bell carriage into a production-ready 2D skeletal puppet PARTS SHEET. Preserve its identical ivory carved stone, dark teal cloth, antique copper/gold, leaves, ornate fine-pixel texture. No redesign. A 3 by 3 grid of NINE isolated complete parts, equal spacious cells, TRUE transparent background outside each part, no labels, no grid lines, no assembled character. Row 1: (1) the complete LOW CHASSIS with ivory animal-faced prow facing RIGHT, teal lower drapery and wooden axle beam, WITHOUT wheels, WITHOUT upper arch, bell or cannon; fill concealed surfaces naturally. (2) the complete UPPER BELL ARCH crowned with leaves, standing upright, including a stable OPAQUE very dark charcoal-brown recessed inner baffle inside the arch, NO bell; NO white/transparent holes inside that baffle, no halo. (3) one complete hanging polished gold BELL with clapper and suspension loop, matching reference, upright. Row 2: (4) complete perfectly circular rear wooden spoked wheel with bronze hub; (5) complete perfectly circular front wooden spoked wheel with bronze hub; BOTH front-facing circular planes, 8 readable radial spokes, no motion blur, no body fragments; (6) complete copper CANNON BARREL isolated, pointing diagonally up LEFT, with fully painted hidden back and rounded breech, no cloth. Row 3: (7) small bronze cannon mounting bracket; (8) the large swept-back dark teal rear CLOTH with ivory trim, complete soft hidden root for pivot attachment; (9) complete short wooden/bronze AXLE/suspension crossmember. All pieces require a little extra painted overlap at joints to prevent seams, but each silhouette must be clean. Hard fine pixel clusters, NO soft gradient glow, no white matte. All nine parts comfortably inside their own cell with large transparent gutters. This is a mechanical rig asset sheet, not nine poses of the whole character.
prompts.windkeeper: Make a production 2D skeletal-puppet PARTS sheet for the EXACT approved ivory/teal wooden guardian in the references. Same fine pixel art, ivory carved armor, braided dark wood, embroidered dark teal cape, copper/gold chest sun. Preserve character identity, do not redesign. FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS: TWELVE SEPARATE isolated components on TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, each in its own spacious cell, no assembled animal, no text/grid/shadows. Row1 left to right: (1) complete horizontal TORSO with original ivory shoulder armor and dark braided wooden belly, gold chest sun attached at front RIGHT, NO head, NO legs, NO large trailing cape. Concealed joints completed naturally. (2) complete pointed ivory DEER HEAD facing RIGHT with antler crown and short neck root, no body; (3) front upper leg/shoulder, short thick braided wooden limb with rounded joint overlap caps, downward orientation; (4) front lower leg with ivory cuff AND large THREE-TOED FOOT attached at bottom, downward orientation. Row2: (5) rear upper/thigh wooden limb with rounded joint overlap caps, downward orientation; (6) rear lower leg with ivory cuff AND large THREE-TOED FOOT at bottom, downward orientation; (7) entire dark teal trailing CAPE with ivory embroidered edge, leaf growth and white flower, facing back to LEFT, completed hidden root; (8) narrow front CHEST BANNER with copper bell decorations, hangs vertically. Row3: (9) complete antler-shaped ivory WINDMILL SUPPORT POLE rooted at head, upright, NO rotor; (10) complete FOUR-BLADED windmill ROTOR, identical blue-teal/ivory cloth sails and bronze central hub from reference2, all four blades complete and unobscured, front-facing plane; (11) rear LEAF/TASSEL TAIL tuft pointing LEFT; (12) small independent gold CHEST SUN medallion ornament. Keep limbs stout and consistent with original. All pieces full silhouettes; paint extra overlap into normally occluded joints so articulation never opens holes. Do not stretch the torso or draw alternate whole-body poses. Crisp square fine-pixel clusters, NO halo, NO flat white/grey matte anywhere. Generous transparent gutters around every cell.
